France

Visa information

Singapore ordinary passport holders do not require a visa for short stays of up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen Area. From the start of operations of the European Entry/Exit System, travellers will be required to register their biometric data at the border.

Please check with the Embassy of France for the latest entry requirements. Singaporeans travelling overseas are encouraged to purchase comprehensive travel insurance and to eRegister with MFA.

Embassy of the Republic of Singapore in Paris, 16 rue Murillo, 75008 Paris. Last updated 3 March 2026.
